note: Franchises whose contract-activity is TEST data, hidden from the Contract Ledger by default. Read by BOTH the desktop FO Misc Contract Log (front_office.js isTestEvent) and the mobile Contracts > Ledger (contracts.js buildIsTestEvent), so they stay in sync. Commish-maintained. To mark only events BEFORE a date as test (once a franchise begins REAL activity), add "before": "YYYY-MM-DD" to its entry; omit `before` to treat the whole franchise as test.
